message:
fix(desktop): wire 採譜 settings into transcription option defaults (#94)

Settings -> 採譜 (tempoMode/bpm/meter/minDuration/triplets) rendered
but never reached the engine — dead controls. Loading a new audio
source now seeds the 採譜オプション defaults from those settings:
triplets-off maps to none (on stays auto — 'always' would change
default quantization); simplicity has no settings counterpart and
stays on its own default.
